lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with rows of high-luminance circular spots on the posterior lateral flank to create a grid-like pattern of nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge along the lateral midline of the caudal peduncle, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct traumatic lesions on the leading edge of the upper caudal lobe: one deep irregular notch containing exposed high-reflectance tissue and one shallower, semi-circular indentation positioned proximal to the first.
other_distinctive_markers: A sparse, non-linear distribution of small, high-luminance spots across the medial and distal surfaces of both the upper and lower caudal fin lobes.
